reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: ML potentials trained on diverse ab initio liquid configurations are well-established to capture many-body interactions better than EAM, directly addressing the phase-space overlap problem in thermodynamic integration.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined quantitative falsification criterion (less than ~20% reduction in mismatch), though the exact metric for 'integration path residuals' could be more precisely specified.
reasons.usefulness: This is a highly useful, actionable hypothesis that directly tackles the core limitation of the TOR-TILD method for high-entropy alloys, proposing a state-of-the-art solution with a concrete predicted improvement.
